name: The Westin Copley Place
positioning: Westin hotel in Boston's Back Bay, connected to Copley Place Mall and The Shops at Prudential Center, with river and city views
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to Copley Square, Trinity Church and Boston Common
Shoppers who want indoor access to Copley Place and the Prudential Center
Families looking for suites with room to spread out

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Back Bay along the Charles River, with an MBTA subway station steps away.
Trinity Church, Boston Public Library, Boston Public Garden and Boston Common are steps from the hotel.
The hotel is within walking distance of the Back Bay Amtrak Station.
Many standard rooms offer views of downtown or the Charles River.
Guest rooms look out over Downtown, Cambridge, Copley Square and Boston Harbor.
Westin Club guests get complimentary daily breakfast with sunrise views across Copley Square.
Bar 10 hosts live entertainment by local musicians every Wednesday, Thursday and Friday.
A complimentary mat Pilates class is led by Boston Body Pilates.
The Kids Camping experience includes a tent, a Boston-themed book and a teddy bear to take home.
The hotel has a Clefs d'Or concierge service.
The hotel is dog-friendly, with a Heavenly Dog Bed for four-legged guests.

highlights.text: Luxury suites are penthouse-inspired, with layouts designed to highlight sweeping views of Back Bay.
River View Studio Suites look out over the Charles River.
The hotel is connected to Copley Place Mall and The Shops at Prudential Center.
The hotel offers Aescape, an intelligent bodywork system that maps the body and adapts sessions in real time.
Bees live on the sixth floor overlooking Copley Square, and their honey is used in the hotel's food and cocktails.

considerations.text: Guests who do not qualify for the Westin Club can buy a daily access pass.
WhataHotel notes it is a large convention hotel with a busy lobby atmosphere.
